control_points_note: Picked by Claude on gridded zooms (1 px = 1 image px); expected picking error 2-4 px in the lithograph. All points lie on the front (south) portico plane. The side colonnade and the street are NOT on this plane and will not align.

observations: Same building and same portico (8 front columns, pediment with relief) in both images.
Lithograph is drawn from the south-west at a strong oblique angle and shows the west colonnade; the photo is nearly frontal and does not show it.
Pediment relief and inscription positions agree in layout; artist's proportions are not guaranteed to be photogrammetric.

alignment.scope: local: control points span 7% of the historic image; trust only the outlined region
